title: Pedal Playground device specifications
description: Ports (jacks) of each device, used by the Signal Flow editor and the Parts List.

key.description: Catalog key: the image filename from pedals.json, plus "~Name" when two pedals share an image (as in My Collection).

subcategory.description: What kind of device this is. "Power Supply" makes it a power supply in Signal Flow and the Parts List.

verified.description: false while the ports are still the generic placeholders; set to true once they match the real device.

sources.description: Where the port and power details came from (manufacturer pages, manuals, spec sheets).

id.description: Unique within the device; cables in saved workspaces refer to it, so avoid renaming it once used.

label.description: Shown on the box in Signal Flow, e.g. "In L", "Send", "EXP".

type.description: Signal type. A jack that carries two types (e.g. a MIDI/EXP jack) lists both, most common first.

direction.description: in, out, or both (e.g. USB, MIDI through/combined jacks). A pedal's power input is listed as in.

side.description: Where the jack is drawn. Default: power and MIDI on the bottom, other inputs left, other outputs right.

connector.description: Plug type. Audio and CTRL jacks use "TS" (mono) or "TRS" (stereo); connecting TRS to TS offers a Y cable. Others are free text, e.g. "5-pin DIN", "USB-C", "XLR", "2.1mm barrel, center negative".

voltage.description: Power jacks only. Volts the pedal needs, or a supply output provides (DC).

current.description: Power jacks only. mA the pedal draws, or the most a supply output can provide.

voltageOptions.description: Supply outputs only. Voltages the output's switch can select; leave empty for a fixed output.

currentByVoltage.description: Switchable supply outputs only. mA available at each switch position, when it drops at higher voltages, e.g. {"9": 500, "12": 275, "18": 250}.
